src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: When was the P4 (Public-Private-People-Partnership) Programme officially launched by the Andhra Pradesh Government?
x: P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership) was launched by CM Naidu and Dy CM Pawan Kalyan at Velagapudi, Amaravati, on Ugadi, Sunday 30 March 2025. It was rolled out statewide only from 19 August 2025, and it was not launched on Republic Day, Independence Day or Diwali.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: A key objective of the Talliki Vandanam Scheme is to reduce the burden of schooling cost, thus improving
o: Increase of literacy rate in students
x: Talliki Vandanam pays ₹15,000 per child a year to mothers to cut the cost of schooling, so that fewer children drop out and the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) rises. It does not target GDP directly, it is not limited to admissions in government schools (private and aided schools are covered too), and it is not a literacy-rate scheme.

s: The APCNF programme introduced by Andhra Pradesh Government has been recognised as the world's largest agroecology programme in terms of the number of farmers enrolled. What is the full form of APCNF?
x: APCNF stands for Andhra Pradesh Community-Managed Natural Farming. It was launched in 2016 and is run by Rythu Sadhikara Samstha (RySS), and it won the 2026 Food Planet Prize. 'Centralised', 'Cultivable' and plain 'Community Natural Farming' are wrong expansions.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: To put drug abuse in check, Government of Andhra Pradesh has set a special task force named
x: AP's anti-drug task force is EAGLE (Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement). It is headquartered at Mangalagiri, has a toll-free number 1972, and the Budget 2026-27 credits it with tackling ganja. ADF, OCTOPUS and SANKALP are not the name of AP's anti-narcotics force.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Which organization signed an MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Government in 2025 to improve health, education and agriculture using technology?
x: The AP government's 2025 partnership with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation uses technology (AI, data, digital public infrastructure) to improve health, education and agriculture; the Foundation is also a partner of Project Sanjeevani. WHO, NITI Aayog and Tata Trusts were not the 2025 MoU partner.

s: What is the upper limit of free treatment coverage provided under the new hybrid model of NTR Vaidya Seva announced in January 2025 in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Under the hybrid model announced in January 2025, insurance covers claims up to ₹2.5 lakh and the Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust funds treatment from ₹2.5 lakh up to ₹25 lakh per family. So the upper limit is ₹25 lakh; ₹10, ₹15 and ₹20 lakh are wrong.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s:
Consider the following statements about the NTR Vaidya Seva Scheme Model of Andhra Pradesh and select the correct option.
Statement 1: The new insurance model will provide health coverage of up to 25 lakh per family annually.
Statement 2: Both public and private insurers will be utilised under this model to ensure broader health coverage for families.
o: Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct.
Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are incorrect.
x: Both are correct: the new NTR Vaidya Seva hybrid model covers up to ₹25 lakh per family a year, and it uses insurers (public and private) for claims up to ₹2.5 lakh while the Trust bears ₹2.5–25 lakh.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: Which State Government is set to introduce Saheli Smart Card to enable free bus travel for women?
x: The (Pink) Saheli Smart Card, an NCMC tap-and-go card for free DTC and cluster bus travel by women and transgender persons, is a Delhi government scheme (2025). Andhra Pradesh's free bus scheme is Stree Shakti (from 15 August 2025), and Telangana's is Mahalakshmi.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: What is the primary objective of the 'Stree Shakti' Scheme launched by the Andhra Pradesh government?
o: To provide free healthcare services to women
To offer free bus travel to women across the state
To distribute financial aid to women entrepreneurs
x: Stree Shakti (Super Six promise) gives free APSRTC bus travel to girls, women and transgender persons across the State from 15 August 2025. It is not a healthcare, financial-aid or empowerment-centre scheme.

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: What is the primary goal of the P4 Program of Andhra Pradesh Government?
o: Developing Andhra Pradesh as IT Hub
x: P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership, launched Ugadi 30 March 2025) aims at complete eradication of poverty ('Zero Poverty'), linked to SDG 1. It is not a family-planning, IT-hub or mother-and-child health programme.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Who was appointed by the Andhra Pradesh government as the head of the one-man commission to examine sub-classification within Scheduled Castes (SCs)?
x: AP appointed retired IAS officer Rajiv Ranjan Mishra as the one-man commission on SC sub-classification (G.O.Ms.No.86, 15 Nov 2024, under the Commission of Inquiry Act, 1952, after the SC's 1 August 2024 verdict); his report (10 March 2025) put the 59 SCs into three groups, implemented by ordinance in April 2025.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: Which district in Andhra Pradesh became the first to have 100% CCTV camera coverage?
x: NTR district (Vijayawada Police Commissionerate, CP S.V. Rajashekhar Babu) became the first in AP to have 100% CCTV coverage, with at least four cameras in each of its 305 inhabited villages (2025). Guntur, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati are not the answer.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: Polam Pilustondi programme of Andhra Pradesh Government aims at
x: Polam Pilustondi ('the field is calling'), launched in 2014, sends agriculture officials and scientists to villages to create awareness among farmers on profitable, low-cost, high-yield farming. It is an extension (awareness) campaign, not an investment, volunteering or farm-tourism programme.

src: Previous paper (title page not in scan)
s: As per the U-DISE data of Government of Andhra Pradesh, the number of schools in Andhra Pradesh are about (choose the nearest figure)?
x:
Printed key: 61,500. U-DISE+ 2024-25 (provisional) gives 58,572 schools, only marginally nearer 61,500 than 55,500 (Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25 p.183).
U-DISE+ puts Andhra Pradesh's schools at roughly 60,000 (58,572 in the provisional 2024-25 data, slightly higher in earlier years), so 61,500 is the nearest option (printed key). 51,500 and 71,500 are far off.
